name: yt-operator-lite
description: Free: your YouTube week in one command - last 7 days vs the 7 before, every new video vs your own median at the same age (engaged views, Shorts and long-form apart), one fix; plus chapters and upload-text checks. Scripts compute from your own channel (Python standard library, read-only sign-in with your own Google OAuth client); Claude only orchestrates. en/de/es/pt/ja.
